title: Older Animations
description: Older Animations is a dependency-less mod created for 1.8.9 that replicates animations and visuals from 1.7, as well as offers a few visual optimizations.
body:
Older Animations provide animations alike ones found in 1.7.x verisons, which are preferred by majority of competitive, as well as casual players. 

Mod provides animations such as:
- Blockhit
- Older eating
- Older enchanting glint
- Older damage tint

...and more!

Our mod requires NO dependencies other than Forge itself. No OneConfig or Essential bloat!

GUI to manage all settings can be opened using /animations in-game.
